title: ApprovalChallenge / ApprovalToken
description: Human authorization for exactly one operation on exactly one resource with exactly these parameters. Single-use, scope-limited, expiring, nonce-bound, and hash-bound to its TaskEnvelope.

actor_user_id.description: The approving human. A writer may not approve its own release or final legal conclusion; a watcher may never approve at all.

step_up_method.description: Consequential approvals require step-up. NONE is only valid for READ_ONLY.

operation.description: Exact adapter operation. An approval for operation A can never authorize operation B.

resource_scope.description: Exact scope. Scope confusion must fail closed.

parameters_sha256.description: Binds the exact parameters. Changing parameters after approval invalidates it.

input_hashes_sha256.description: Binds the artifact state observed at approval time. If an artifact changed after approval, execution aborts.

policy_version.description: A policy version change invalidates outstanding approvals.
